title: Unable to use the Wayland display service after export with `template_release`.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.dev.mono.gh [bbe965432]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev.mono (bbe965432) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 14 Nov 2025 13:09:06 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 580.105.08) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.46 GiB memory

### Issue description

Unable to confirm if there is an issue with exporting using `template_debug`, as neither the GitHub Actions in the Godot repository nor my computer have a build for `template_debug`.

### Steps to reproduce

In the project settings, change the Linux display service to `wayland` (or run the project with `--display-driver wayland`), and the log shows `ERROR: Can't connect to a Wayland display.`
